title: 第3章 初临异世 猎杀魔兽

content_zh:
一周时间在修炼之中转瞬既过。
刘枫丹田之中的真气越来越多，以这种进度，最多再过得一月的时间，便能积累到足够的真气进行“冲穴”大任。
不过，由于所备食物已不多，刘枫也只得停止下修炼，开始分出一些时间猎杀魔兽，顺便练练手。
提着铁剑，跳下山洞，四处望了望，却没见到什么魔兽，这让刘枫非常疑惑，一般在森林之中，有水源的地方，一向是动物的聚集区，可这里怎么一只都没有啊，难道地球上的理念在这个世界行不通么？
郁闷的想了半晌后，刘枫慢慢的向“死亡森林”外围走去，凭他现在的能力去深处的话，只是给那些强大的魔兽添上一道人肉菜肴罢了。
走了十几分钟后，一声虎吼从前方传来，大喜的刘枫连忙朝前奔去，穿过几棵巨树，视野突然开阔了起来，刘枫眼前一亮，嘿，好家伙。
只见前方十几米的空地上，俩头魔兽正在进行着殊死拼斗。
“三阶魔兽，赤魔虎。”
“四阶魔兽，大地暴熊。”
很明显的赤魔虎身处下风，毫无森林之王的派头，被大地魔熊的一双巨掌煽得狼狈不堪，四处闪躲，眼看就支撑不了多久。
所谓，兔子急了也咬人呢，更何况是本就残暴的赤魔虎，被逼得毫无退路的赤魔虎，再次被轮翻之后，仰天狂吼，火元素迅速的集结在口中，由深黄变成浅红色，虽然颜色变淡了，但是刘枫能够清晰的感觉到，火球中的火元素却变得极其暴躁了。
浅红火球从口中急速喷出，疾射向立起身的大地魔熊。
“嘭”，爆炸声猛的响起，带起一阵沙雾，遮住了战场，半晌后，尘埃落定，刘枫忙伸起脖子观望。
战场之中，赤魔虎腹部似乎是被什么东西刺穿了般，肠子“哗哗”的不住向外流，鲜血躺了一地，明显已经死去，而对面的大地魔熊也是胸前一片焦黑，鲜血直淌的坐在地上不住喘着粗气，这场争斗的胜利者显然是它。
“嘿嘿，不过，你们最后还是便宜了少爷我。”刘枫嘴角露出一丝奸笑，现出身来，抗着铁剑，大踏步的朝死去的赤魔虎走去。
大地魔熊察觉到这个突然出现的人类的目的，却并没有露出任何暴怒的神情，只是低垂的巨大熊眼中闪过一丝嘲讽。
站在赤魔虎身边正要动手挖出魔晶的刘枫，突然心中一紧，“疾风步”瞬间启动，消失在大地魔熊的视线里，凭借“疾风步”的特效速度。刘枫迅速的离开了原地，在刘枫前脚刚走，所在之地就微一摇晃，紧接着，“嘭嘭”声不断响起。
刘枫站在几十米远处，看着那被尖锐的石柱所布满的方圆几米处，已经被穿成了好几段的赤魔虎的尸体，背心一阵发凉。
看着正茫然四顾寻找自己的大地魔熊，刘枫心中顿时恼羞成怒：“想不到，在这憨厚的外表之下，竟有着如此狡猾的心计。”
借着“疾风步”的时间还剩下十来秒，刘枫脚尖轻点，迅速闪到大地魔熊背后，内力灌注手中铁剑，全力刺向它后背的那一掠白色毛发。

铁剑带着风雷之声，“哧”的刺进了大地魔熊的要害处。
拔剑，疾退。
铁剑斜指，鲜血随之滴下，刘枫眼神冰冷的看着仰天惨嚎的大地魔熊，背后要害处，鲜血激射而出。
心中默念：“一。。二。。三。。倒。”
“轰嗒”一声，惨嚎中的魔熊应声立刻倒塌在地。
********
看着手这俩颗丑不拉几的石头，刘枫郁闷不已：“这就是传说中的魔晶？杂这么丑勒。”
随手把魔晶收进怀里，抗着俩只熊掌的刘枫回到了瀑布边。
升火，起架，穿熊掌。
看着在火堆上不断冒着香的熊掌，刘枫心中不由想道：嘿嘿，劳资在地球上吃不起熊掌，但是在异界吃得起啊，而且还吃一只丢一只，哈哈。”
想到这里的刘枫不禁感叹道：“穿越，真TM的幸福啊。”
狼吞虎咽的解决俩只熊掌的刘枫，随脚把火堆灭了，踢上沙土埋了上去，然后翻身进洞，继续修炼。
时间在刘枫忘时的修炼中一天一天的过去了，体内丹田中的真气也越来越多，经脉中转换的速度也越来越快，刘枫有预感，自己化蝶的时间近了。
今天，又是如往常一般入定的刘枫，忽然，天地间的元气忽然骚动了，在入定中的刘枫头顶上空半尺处，隐隐的形成了一个元气旋涡，疯狂的吸收着一切元气，包括那些魔法元素和斗气能量，再经过转换，源源不断的灌入了刘枫头顶“百会穴”所在。

content_en:
A week passed in a blink of an eye during practice.
There is more and more true energy in Liu Feng's dantian. At this rate, it will only take another month at most before he can accumulate enough true energy to carry out the task of "point acupuncture".
However, since there was not much food left, Liu Feng had to stop practicing and began to spend some time hunting monsters and practicing his skills.
Holding the iron sword, he jumped down from the cave and looked around, but he didn't see any magical beasts. This made Liu Feng very puzzled. Generally speaking, in forests, places with water sources have always been areas where animals gather, but why is there not one here? Could it be that the concepts on earth don't work in this world?
After thinking depressedly for a long time, Liu Feng slowly walked towards the outskirts of the "Forest of Death". With his current ability, if he went deep into it, he would just add a human dish to those powerful monsters.
After walking for more than ten minutes, a tiger roar came from the front. The overjoyed Liu Feng hurried forward and passed through several giant trees. His field of vision suddenly broadened. Liu Feng's eyes lit up, Hey, good guy.
In the open space more than ten meters ahead, two monsters were fighting to the death.
"Third-level monster, Red Devil Tiger."
"The fourth-level monster, the violent earth bear."
It was obvious that the Red Devil Tiger was at a disadvantage and had no bearing on the king of the forest. He was in a state of panic by the giant palms of the Earth Devil Bear. He was dodging around and it seemed that he could not hold on for long.
The so-called rabbit bites people when it is anxious, not to mention the cruel Red Devil Tiger. After being turned over again, the Red Devil Tiger roared to the sky. The fire element quickly gathered in his mouth, turning from dark yellow to light red. Although the color became lighter, Liu Feng could clearly feel that the fire element in the fire ball had become extremely violent.
Light red fireballs quickly erupted from the mouth and shot towards the standing Earth Demon Bear.
"Bang", the explosion sounded fiercely, bringing up a burst of sand and fog, covering the battlefield. After a while, the dust settled, and Liu Feng hurriedly stretched his neck to watch.
In the battlefield, the Red Demon Tiger's abdomen seemed to have been pierced by something. His intestines kept flowing out, and blood lay on the ground. He was obviously dead. The Earth Demon Bear opposite also had a scorched black chest and sat on the ground panting with blood. It was obviously the winner of this battle.
"Hehe, but in the end, you still took advantage of me, young master." Liu Feng showed a wicked smile on his lips, appeared, resisted the iron sword, and strode towards the dead Red Devil Tiger.
The Earth Demon Bear noticed the purpose of this suddenly appearing human being, but did not show any angry expression. There was only a hint of ridicule in the huge bear's eyes.
Liu Feng, who was standing next to the Red Devil Tiger and was about to dig out the magic crystal, suddenly felt his heart tightening. "Wind Step" was activated instantly and disappeared from the sight of the Earth Demon Bear, relying on the special effects speed of "Wind Step". Liu Feng quickly left the place. As soon as Liu Feng stepped forward, the place he was on shook slightly, and then, "bang bang" sounds continued to sound.
Liu Feng stood dozens of meters away, looking at the body of the Red Devil Tiger that had been cut into several sections in a radius of several meters surrounded by sharp stone pillars, and felt a chill in his vest.
Looking at the Earth Demon Bear who was looking around blankly for him, Liu Feng suddenly became angry and angry: "I never expected that there is such a cunning scheme under this simple and honest appearance."
With about ten seconds left in the "Wind Step", Liu Feng tapped his toes and quickly dodged behind the Earth Demon Bear. He poured his inner strength into the iron sword in his hand and stabbed the white hair on its back with all his strength.
With the sound of wind and thunder, the iron sword stabbed into the vital part of the Earth Demon Bear.
Draw your sword and retreat quickly.
The iron sword pointed obliquely, and blood dripped down. Liu Feng looked at the earth demon bear looking up to the sky and howling miserably with cold eyes. Blood spurted out from the vital parts of his back.
I thought silently in my mind: "One...two...three...down."
"Boom", the howling demon bearHe immediately collapsed to the ground.
**********
Looking at the two ugly stones in his hands, Liu Feng was depressed: "Is this the legendary magic crystal? It's so ugly."
Liu Feng casually put the magic crystal into his arms and returned to the waterfall while resisting the two bear's paws.
Raise the fire, raise the frame, and wear the bear's paws.
Looking at the bear paws that were constantly smelling fragrant on the fire, Liu Feng couldn't help but think: Hey, labor and management can't afford bear paws on earth, but they can afford them in other worlds, and they even eat one and lose one, haha. "
Thinking of this, Liu Feng couldn't help but sigh: "Time travel is such a fucking blessing. "
Liu Feng, who wolfed down the two bear paws, extinguished the fire with his feet, kicked up the sand and buried it, then turned over and entered the hole to continue practicing.
Time passed day by day in Liu Feng's forgetful practice, and the amount of true energy in his body's Dantian became more and more, and the speed of transformation in his meridians became faster and faster. Liu Feng had a hunch that the time for him to transform into a butterfly was near.
Today, Liu Feng was in trance as usual. Suddenly, the energy between heaven and earth suddenly stirred. Half a foot above the head of Liu Feng, who was in trance, a vortex of energy was faintly formed. It frantically absorbed all the energy, including the magic elements and fighting energy. After conversion, it continuously poured into the "Baihui Point" above Liu Feng's head.
